notes: Slim broker, sold in the drop window (the Cortex mercenary store). Mercenaries for one drop: Punch of Thugs, Grunt Stream (four waves), Wasp Flight (very dear). Heroes for hire for one drop: Marrow Gale's Cutlasses and Bro's Tzar; win the campaign with one in the company and it is a starter from then on. Build rights: one Cortex constructor (and one Armada constructor at high Armada rep). The Cortex commander suit (verdance.campaign.suits). Crash of Brutes retired 2026-10-27 (pruned). Tnb for build rights and heroes; metal for everything.

resource.label: Tenebrium
resource.lore: Black-hole distillate metal from BAR lore. Scarce since the Generic Disaster. Build-power units cost ≥1 Tnb (ceil(buildSpeed/150)). Experimental Foundries cost 7. Named heavies stake Tnb (Sol Invictus 4, Behemoth 5, Titan 2, Juggernaut 3, Razorback 1, Thor/Catapult/Demon 2); Vanguard/Shiva/Karganeth and other combat default free. Stake lives on the unit until reclaim or vaporize. Infinite storage. Q7 is the scarcity qubit. Armada spent their stock on decoy farms — crisis, bank 0.

metal.label: Metal
metal.notes: Fresh run starts at 7×1km$. Campaign bag stays home — each sortie gets fieldStartMetalK as operating metal; floor(endMetal/1000) − fieldStart ADDS to the faction bag on extract (never replaces). Spend bag km$ in hub shop. Not a substitute for Tenebrium on build gear.

punch_of_thugs.label: Punch of Thugs
punch_of_thugs.blurb: Pawn launcher salvo: 7 Cortex Thugs land with your infil. Chaff to throw in front of your heroes. Buy again to stack.

recommend.why: Two Punches make the first raid on Greenest Fields far kinder.

grunt_stream.label: Grunt Stream
grunt_stream.blurb: Infantry chaff that keeps coming: four waves of five Cortex Grunts spill from All That Simmers' geo-vents, 45 seconds apart.

wasp_flight.label: Wasp Flight
wasp_flight.blurb: Cortex mercenary gunships: four Wasps, hired by the sortie and priced like it. They arrive from the Eye of Horus mid-sortie.

rent_gale.label: Rent Marrow Gale · Cutlass wing
rent_gale.blurb: Cortex lends you Marrow Gale and six Cutlass seaplanes for one drop. Expensive. Win the campaign with Gale in your company and Gale is yours to start with from then on.

rent_bro.label: Rent Bro · the Tzar
rent_bro.blurb: Cortex lends you Bro and his Tzar for one drop. Very expensive. Win the campaign with Bro in your company and Bro is yours to start with from then on.

cortex_constructor.label: Cortex Constructor
cortex_constructor.blurb: Buy the right to build — one Cortex construction bot for the kit.

cortex_commander_suit.label: Cortex Commander Suit
cortex_commander_suit.blurb: Cortex will sell you a commander suit, and they want an outrageous price for it. You need a suit to duel in All That Simmers. Wear theirs and Cortex won't turn up for that fight.

armada_constructor.label: Armada Constructor
armada_constructor.blurb: High Armada reputation opens their construction bots. Costs Tenebrium.

tenebriumOnZoneFlip.notes: No free Tnb mint on node claim / zone flip. Liquid Tnb only via reclaim or rare victory scavenge.

metalOnExtract.notes: Campaign metal banked from player team end stockpile. Replaces retired scrap creditsOnVictory.
